note: Harmony-line step 1 as an ear game: two notes at once, a 3rd, a 4th or a 5th apart, each hummed apart before it is named; the answers are named as the game's buttons show them, with their meaning beside them, and the block names its feel to reach.

exercise.title: Two notes at once
exercise.why: A harmony is two notes heard together, so humming the lower note and then the upper one teaches your ear to pull them apart before your voice holds one of them.

cells.text:
Press Start below to hear two notes at the same time, a 3rd, a 4th or a 5th apart. Hum the lower note, then the upper one.
Then pick its name: m3 for a minor 3rd, M3 for a major 3rd, P4 for a 4th, P5 for a 5th.
Practice until you hear both notes before you hum them.
